newsitem.title: USA: Medirisk IPO set for this week.
newsitem.headline: Medirisk IPO set for this week.

text.p: Medirisk Inc's initial public offering is scheduled to go public this week after the company cut the number of shares to be offered and switched underwriters.
The deal is tentatively scheduled for the middle of this week, lead underwriter Equitable Securities Co said Monday.

The Atlanta company provides database and decision-support software. It plans to offer 2.5 million shares in an estimated price range of $11 to $13 each, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company originally filed in September 1996 for an IPO of three million shares in the same price range, with Smith Barney as the lead underwriter. Equitable Securities was one of the comanagers of the deal in the original filing.
